remaining_open_items: RthJA and Tj maximum are absent for the red reference; thermal acceptance must remain unknown.
Green catalog role permutation remains explicit and unchanged; selecting a color does not establish a different MPN automatically.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Thermal acceptance lacks sourced junction/thermal parameters; generic color variants lack an exact reference. Resolution: Not closable with the current reference: the current Vishay VLMS1300 sheet (Rev 1.6, 30-Mar-2023, archived c5cea115) and the older Rev 1.4 copy contain no junction temperature and no thermal resistance, only PV 75 mW at Tamb <= 25 C and Tamb -35..+85 C. Every bound LED recipe carries sourced rth_ja and tj_max, and binding without them would make the junction check silently absent (ratings.py adds it only when both exist), against D015. A closable route requires changing the reference part to an 0603 LED that publishes thermal data: Kingbright APT1608SURCK (hyper red, same maker family as the bound OHM-077/079/080 Kingbright parts). WebFetch of the Kingbright PDF (spec DSAD0926, Rev V.22A, 04/08/2023) shows Tj 115 C, RthJA 480 C/W and RthJS 310 C/W (FR4, pad >= 16 mm2 per pad), PD 75 mW, IF 30 mA, VR 5 V, VF 1.95 typ / 2.5 max at 20 mA. It must be browser-archived, its package drawing (cathode mark) viewed, and the rebind approved (D047: rebinds need a change of reference part). The generic colour/green catalog binding (GENERIC_LED_GREEN) stays unbound: the recipe names one red part and carries no catalog_parts.
